events.title: Canada Day (Museum Open House)
events.description: Join us for a vibrant Canada Day celebration filled with family-friendly activities, live entertainment, and community spirit. Enjoy inflatables, games, music, local performances, and delicious food—all set against the stunning backdrop of Lunenburg’s historic waterfront. Bring your friends, family, and Canadian pride for a day full of celebration and connection.

events.title: Pianocean - NOVA SCOTIA TOUR
events.description: This summer, the internationally acclaimed Pianocean project arrives in Nova Scotia as part of its ongoing round-the-world sailing voyage, celebrating ten years of music, adventure, and cultural exchange across the world's oceans. This unique sailing-and-music project will bring floating piano concerts first to Lunenburg, then to Halifax, St. Peters, and Baddeck.
